570	    radius = Math.max(15, Math.min(25, radius));

572	    const y0 = Math.floor(py - radius / 2), y1 = Math.floor(py + radius / 2);
573	    for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
574	      for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {
575	        if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
576	        const d = Math.hypot(x - px, y - py);
577	        const ti = st.idx(x, y);
578	        if (d < radius * 0.2) {
579	          st.type[ti] = 0; st.flags[ti] = 0; st.wall[ti] = 83;
580	        } else if (d < radius * 0.5 && st.wall[ti] !== 83) {
581	          st.flags[ti] = 1; st.type[ti] = CRIMSTONE;

584	      }

596	/** CrimEnt(L45689)1:1:水平入口隧道,只贯穿猩红石,连续 20 步无肉即停 */
597	function crimEnt(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x0: number, y0: number, dir: number): void {
598	  let radius = rng.int(6, 10);
599	  const vx = 2 * -dir;
600	  let vy = rng.int(-20, -1) * 0.01;
601	  let px = x0 + 0.0, py = y0 + 0.0;
602	  let misses = 0;
603	  while (misses < 20) {
604	    misses++;
605	    radius += rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.02;
606	    radius = Math.max(6, Math.min(10, radius));
607	    const bx0 = Math.floor(px - radius / 2), bx1 = Math.floor(px + radius / 2);
608	    const by0 = Math.floor(py - radius / 2), by1 = Math.floor(py + radius / 2);
609	    for (let x = bx0; x < bx1; x++) {
610	      for (let y = by0; y < by1; y++) {
611	        if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
612	        const ti = st.idx(x, y);
613	        if (st.flags[ti] && st.type[ti] === CRIMSTONE && Math.hypot(x - px, y - py) < radius * 0.5) {
614	          st.type[ti] = 0; st.flags[ti] = 0;
615	          misses = 0;
616	        }
617	      }
618	    }
619	    px += vx; py += vy;
620	  }
621	}

function band(

  count: number, yMin: number, yMax: number,
  type: number, s: [number, number], steps: [number, number],
) {

163	}

165	export function runDesertPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
166	  const { w, h } = st;
167	  const desc = runDesertMoundOnly(st, rng, gs);
168	  // ---- DesertHive(DesertHive.cs 1:1):椭圆散点 → 深度2 DFS 簇 → AttemptClaim 合并
169	  // 场强 = 各簇内全部块的 Σ1/d²,取前二大簇求和;阈值 3.5/1.8/0.7/0.25 ----
170	  const cellW = 4, cellH = 2;
171	  const gw = desc.blockCols, gh = desc.blockRows;
172	  // 1) 椭圆掩码 50% 散点(ClusterGroup.Generate)
173	  const blockMap: boolean[][] = [];
174	  for (let c = 0; c < gw; c++) blockMap.push(new Array(gh).fill(false));
175	  {
176	    const num1 = Math.floor(gw / 2) - 1, y1 = Math.max(1, Math.floor(gh / 2) - 1);
177	    const num2 = (num1 + 1) * (num1 + 1);
178	    for (let r = 0; r < gh; r++) {
179	      const num3 = (num1 / y1) * (r - y1);
180	      const num4 = Math.min(num1, Math.floor(Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, num2 - num3 * num3))));
181	      for (let c = num1 - num4; c <= num1 + num4; c++) {
182	        if (c < 0 || c >= gw) continue;
183	        blockMap[c][r] = rng.int(0, 1) === 0;
184	      }
185	    }
186	  }
187	  // 2) 深度 2 DFS 搜簇(起点再过 50%),>2 点保留
188	  const pointClusters: Array<Array<[number, number]>> = [];
189	  {
190	    const dfs = (x: number, y: number, level: number, out: Array<[number, number]>) => {
191	      out.push([x, y]);
192	      blockMap[x][y] = false;
193	      level--;
194	      if (level === -1) return;
195	      if (x > 0 && blockMap[x - 1][y]) dfs(x - 1, y, level, out);
196	      if (x < gw - 1 && blockMap[x + 1][y]) dfs(x + 1, y, level, out);
197	      if (y > 0 && blockMap[x][y - 1]) dfs(x, y - 1, level, out);
198	      if (y < gh - 1 && blockMap[x][y + 1]) dfs(x, y + 1, level, out);
199	    };
200	    for (let x = 0; x < gw; x++) {
201	      for (let y = 0; y < gh; y++) {
202	        if (blockMap[x][y] && rng.int(0, 1) === 0) {
203	          const pc: Array<[number, number]> = [];
204	          dfs(x, y, 2, pc);
205	          if (pc.length > 2) pointClusters.push(pc);
206	        }
207	      }
208	    }
209	  }
210	  // 3) 索引图 + AttemptClaim:邻簇随机整体并入或删除
211	  const idxMap: number[][] = [];
212	  for (let c = 0; c < gw; c++) idxMap.push(new Array(gh).fill(-1));
213	  pointClusters.forEach((pc, i) => { for (const [px, py] of pc) idxMap[px][py] = i; });
214	  for (let i = 0; i < pointClusters.length; i++) {
215	    for (const [px, py] of pointClusters[i]) {
216	      if (idxMap[px][py] === -1) break;
217	      const ci = idxMap[px][py];
218	      const claim = (nx: number, ny: number) => {
219	        if (nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nx >= gw || ny >= gh) return;
220	        const other = idxMap[nx][ny];
221	        if (other === -1 || other === ci) return;
222	        const val = rng.int(0, 1) === 0 ? -1 : ci;
223	        for (const [qx, qy] of pointClusters[other]) idxMap[qx][qy] = val;
224	      };
225	      claim(px - 1, py); claim(px + 1, py); claim(px, py - 1); claim(px, py + 1);
226	    }
227	  }
228	  // 4) 重组成簇,<4 点丢弃;块坐标 ±0.25 抖动
229	  const clusters: Array<Array<[number, number]>> = pointClusters.map(() => []);
230	  for (let x = 0; x < gw; x++) {
231	    for (let y = 0; y < gh; y++) {
232	      if (idxMap[x][y] !== -1) clusters[idxMap[x][y]].push([x, y]);
233	    }
234	  }
235	  const finalClusters: Array<Array<[number, number]>> = [];
236	  for (const cl of clusters) {
237	    if (cl.length < 4) continue;
238	    finalClusters.push(cl.map(([bx, by]) => [
239	      bx + (rng.next() - 0.5) * 0.5, by + (rng.next() - 0.5) * 0.5,
240	    ] as [number, number]));
241	  }
242	  const hiveW = desc.combW, hiveH = desc.hiveH;
243	  // ---- 场强分层(PlaceClustersArea):±10 窗口判簇(簇首块),簇内求和取前二大 ----
244	  for (let dx = -20; dx < hiveW + 20; dx++) {
245	    for (let dy = -20; dy < hiveH + 20; dy++) {
246	      const px = desc.combX + dx, py = desc.hiveTop + dy;
247	      if (!st.inBounds(px, py)) continue;
248	      let shellType: number = SAND;
249	      if (rng.int(0, 2) === 0) shellType = HARDSAND;
250	      const vx = dx / cellW - 0.5, vy = dy / cellH - 0.5;
251	      let m1 = 0, m2 = 0, m1Idx = -1;
252	      for (let ci = 0; ci < finalClusters.length; ci++) {
253	        const c0 = finalClusters[ci][0];
254	        if (Math.abs(c0[0] - vx) > 10 || Math.abs(c0[1] - vy) > 10) continue;
255	        let f = 0;
256	        for (const [bx, by] of finalClusters[ci]) {
257	          const ddx = bx - vx, ddy = by - vy;
258	          f += 1 / (ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy);
259	        }
260	        if (f > m1) { if (m1 > m2) m2 = m1; m1 = f; m1Idx = ci; }
261	        else if (f > m2) m2 = f;
262	      }
263	      const field = m1 + m2;
264	      const ex = (dx / hiveW) * 2 - 1, ey = (dy / hiveH) * 2 - 1;
265	      const isEdge = Math.hypot(ex, ey) >= 0.8;
266	      const i = st.idx(px, py);
267	      if (field > 3.5) {
268	        // 腔室:清空 + 墙187;获胜簇索引 %15==2 → 化石(确定性判定)
269	        st.type[i] = 0; st.flags[i] = 0; st.liquid[i] = 0; st.liquidType[i] = 0;
270	        st.wall[i] = 187;
271	        if (m1Idx % 15 === 2) { st.type[i] = FOSSIL; st.flags[i] = 1; }
272	      } else if (field > 1.8) {
273	        // 隧道带:墙187 + 沙岩;地表以下注岩浆
274	        st.wall[i] = 187;
275	        if (py < gs.worldSurface) { st.liquid[i] = 0; st.liquidType[i] = 0; }
276	        else st.liquidType[i] = 2;
277	        if (!isEdge || st.flags[i]) { st.type[i] = SANDSTONE; st.flags[i] = 1; }
278	      } else if (field > 0.7 || !isEdge) {
279	        // 硬化沙壳:墙216 + 沙/硬化沙(1/3)
280	        st.wall[i] = 216;
281	        st.liquid[i] = 0; st.liquidType[i] = 0;
282	        if (!isEdge || st.flags[i]) { st.type[i] = shellType; st.flags[i] = 1; }
283	      } else if (field > 0.25 && rng.next() < (field - 0.25) / 0.45) {
284	        // 隧道外缘噪声
285	        st.wall[i] = 187;
286	        if (py < gs.worldSurface) { st.liquid[i] = 0; st.liquidType[i] = 0; }
287	        else st.liquidType[i] = 2;
288	        if (st.flags[i]) { st.type[i] = shellType; st.flags[i] = 1; }
289	      }
290	    }
291	  }
292	  // ---- AddTileVariance:沙 53 下方 2 格非实心 → 酥化为 397(装饰 485/484/165/187 略)----
293	  for (let dx = -20; dx < desc.combW + 20; dx++) {
294	    for (let dy = -20; dy < hiveH + 20; dy++) {
295	      const px = desc.combX + dx, py = desc.hiveTop + dy;
296	      if (!st.inBounds(px, py) || !st.inBounds(px, py + 2)) continue;
297	      const i = st.idx(px, py);
298	      if (st.type[i] === SAND && st.flags[i]
299	        && !(st.isSolid(px, py + 1) && st.isSolid(px, py + 2))) {
300	        st.type[i] = HARDSAND;
301	      }
302	    }
303	  }
304	
305	  // ---- 入口（33%，DesertBiome.cs:24-45）：★四种入口待移植（Sub-C），暂用简化竖井
306	  // 但掷骰结构对齐：NextDouble<=ChanceOfEntrance 后必掷 Next(4) 类型骰（Sub-C 前提）
307	  if (rng.next() <= 0.3333) {
308	    const kind = rng.nextIntRange(0, 4); // Chambers/Anthill/LarvaHole/Pit（暂不分支）
309	    void kind;
310	    const ex = desc.combX + rng.int(Math.floor(desc.combW * 0.2), Math.floor(desc.combW * 0.8));
311	    let ey = 0;
312	    while (ey < h - 2 && !st.flags[st.idx(ex, ey)]) ey++;
313	    const shaftW = rng.int(0, 3) === 0 ? 8 : 4;
314	    for (let y = ey - 2; y <= desc.hiveTop + 8; y++) {
315	      for (let dx = 0; dx < shaftW; dx++) {
316	        if (!st.inBounds(ex + dx, y)) continue;
317	        const i = st.idx(ex + dx, y);
318	        st.type[i] = 0; st.flags[i] = 0;
319	        st.wall[i] = 187;
320	      }
321	    }
322	  }
323	
324	  // ExportDescriptionToEngine（DesertBiome.cs:54-58）：CombinedArea.Inflate(10,10)
325	  gs.undergroundDesert = {
326	    x0: Math.max(0, desc.combX - 10), y0: Math.max(0, desc.combY - 10),
327	    x1: Math.min(w, desc.combX + desc.combW + 10),
328	    y1: Math.min(h, desc.combY + desc.combH + 10),
329	  };
330	}

using Microsoft.Xna.Framework;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Terraria.GameContent.Biomes.Desert;
using Terraria.WorldBuilding;

namespace Terraria.GameContent.Biomes;

public class DesertBiome : MicroBiome
{
	[JsonProperty("ChanceOfEntrance")]
	public double ChanceOfEntrance = 0.3333;

	public override bool Place(Point origin, StructureMap structures, GenerationProgress progress)
	{
		DesertDescription desertDescription = DesertDescription.CreateFromPlacement(origin);
		if (!desertDescription.IsValid)
		{
			return false;
		}
		ExportDescriptionToEngine(desertDescription);
		SandMound.Place(desertDescription, progress, 0f, 0.1f);
		desertDescription.UpdateSurfaceMap();
		if (!Main.tenthAnniversaryWorld && GenBase._random.NextDouble() <= ChanceOfEntrance && !WorldGen.SecretSeed.extraLiquid.Enabled)
		{
			switch (GenBase._random.Next(4))
			{
			case 0:
				ChambersEntrance.Place(desertDescription, progress, 0.1f, 0.2f);
				break;
			case 1:
				AnthillEntrance.Place(desertDescription, progress, 0.1f, 0.2f);
				break;
			case 2:
				LarvaHoleEntrance.Place(desertDescription, progress, 0.1f, 0.2f);
				break;
			case 3:
				PitEntrance.Place(desertDescription, progress, 0.1f, 0.2f);
				break;
			}
		}
		DesertHive.Place(desertDescription, progress, 0.2f, 0.75f);
		CleanupArea(desertDescription.Hive, progress, 0.75f, 1f);
		Rectangle area = new Rectangle(desertDescription.CombinedArea.X, 50, desertDescription.CombinedArea.Width, desertDescription.CombinedArea.Bottom - 20);
		structures.AddStructure(area, 10);
		return true;
	}

	private static void ExportDescriptionToEngine(DesertDescription description)
	{
		GenVars.UndergroundDesertLocation = description.CombinedArea;
		GenVars.UndergroundDesertLocation.Inflate(10, 10);
		GenVars.UndergroundDesertHiveLocation = description.Hive;
	}

	private static void CleanupArea(Rectangle area, GenerationProgress progress, float progressMin, float progressMax)
	{
		int num = 20 - area.Left;
		int num2 = num + area.Right + 20;
		for (int i = -20 + area.Left; i < area.Right + 20; i++)
		{
			progress.Set((float)(i + num) / (float)num2, progressMin, progressMax);
			for (int j = -20 + area.Top; j < area.Bottom + 20; j++)
			{
				if (i > 0 && i < Main.maxTilesX - 1 && j > 0 && j < Main.maxTilesY - 1)
				{
					WorldGen.SquareWallFrame(i, j);
					WorldUtils.TileFrame(i, j, frameNeighbors: true);
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

using Microsoft.Xna.Framework;
using ReLogic.Utilities;
using Terraria.WorldBuilding;

namespace Terraria.GameContent.Biomes.Desert;

public static class AnthillEntrance
{
	public static void Place(DesertDescription description, GenerationProgress progress, float progressMin, float progressMax)
	{
		int num = WorldGen.genRand.Next(2, 4);
		for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
		{
			progress.Set((float)i / (float)num, progressMin, progressMax);
			int holeRadius = WorldGen.genRand.Next(15, 18);
			int num2 = (int)((double)(i + 1) / (double)(num + 1) * (double)description.Surface.Width);
			num2 += description.Desert.Left;
			int y = description.Surface[num2];
			PlaceAt(description, new Point(num2, y), holeRadius);
		}
	}

	private static void PlaceAt(DesertDescription description, Point position, int holeRadius)
	{
		//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		ShapeData data = new ShapeData();
		Point origin = new Point(position.X, position.Y + 6);
		WorldUtils.Gen(origin, new Shapes.Tail(holeRadius * 2, new Vector2D(0.0, (double)(-holeRadius) * 1.5)), Actions.Chain(new Actions.SetTile(53).Output(data)));
		GenShapeActionPair genShapeActionPair = new GenShapeActionPair(new Shapes.Rectangle(1, 1), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.Blotches(), new Modifiers.IsSolid(), new Actions.Clear(), new Actions.PlaceWall(187)));
		GenShapeActionPair genShapeActionPair2 = new GenShapeActionPair(new Shapes.Rectangle(1, 1), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.IsSolid(), new Actions.Clear(), new Actions.PlaceWall(187)));
		GenShapeActionPair pair = new GenShapeActionPair(new Shapes.Circle(2, 3), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.IsSolid(), new Actions.SetTile(397), new Actions.PlaceWall(187)));
		GenShapeActionPair pair2 = new GenShapeActionPair(new Shapes.Circle(holeRadius, 3), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.SkipWalls(187), new Actions.SetTile(53)));
		GenShapeActionPair pair3 = new GenShapeActionPair(new Shapes.Circle(holeRadius - 2, 3), Actions.Chain(new Actions.PlaceWall(187)));
		int num = position.X;
		for (int i = position.Y - holeRadius - 3; i < description.Hive.Top + (position.Y - description.Desert.Top) * 2 + 12; i++)
		{
			WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(num, i), (i < position.Y) ? genShapeActionPair2 : genShapeActionPair);
			WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(num, i), pair);
			if (i % 3 == 0 && i >= position.Y)
			{
				num += WorldGen.genRand.Next(-1, 2);
				WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(num, i), genShapeActionPair);
				if (i >= position.Y + 5)
				{
					WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(num, i), pair2);
					WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(num, i), pair3);
				}
				WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(num, i), pair);
			}
		}
		WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(origin.X, origin.Y - (int)((double)holeRadius * 1.5) + 3), new Shapes.Circle(holeRadius / 2, holeRadius / 3), Actions.Chain(Actions.Chain(new Actions.ClearTile(), new Modifiers.Expand(1), new Actions.PlaceWall(0))));
		WorldUtils.Gen(origin, new ModShapes.All(data), new Actions.Smooth());
	}
}

{
	public static void Place(DesertDescription description, GenerationProgress progress, float progressMin, float progressMax)

			num2 += description.Desert.Left;
			int y = description.Surface[num2];
			PlaceAt(description, new Point(num2, y), holeRadius);
		}
	}

	private static void PlaceAt(DesertDescription description, Point position, int holeRadius)
	{

		ShapeData data = new ShapeData();
		WorldUtils.Gen(position, new Shapes.Rectangle(new Rectangle(-holeRadius, -holeRadius * 2, holeRadius * 2, holeRadius * 2)), new Actions.Clear().Output(data));
		WorldUtils.Gen(position, new Shapes.Tail(holeRadius * 2, new Vector2D(0.0, (double)holeRadius * 1.5)), Actions.Chain(new Actions.Clear().Output(data)));
		WorldUtils.Gen(position, new ModShapes.All(data), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.Offset(0, 1), new Modifiers.Expand(1), new Modifiers.IsSolid(), new Actions.Smooth(applyToNeighbors: true)));
		GenShapeActionPair pair = new GenShapeActionPair(new Shapes.Rectangle(1, 1), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.Blotches(), new Modifiers.IsSolid(), new Actions.Clear(), new Actions.PlaceWall(187)));
		GenShapeActionPair pair2 = new GenShapeActionPair(new Shapes.Circle(2, 3), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.IsSolid(), new Actions.SetTile(397), new Actions.PlaceWall(187)));
		int num = position.X;

using System;
using Microsoft.Xna.Framework;
using Terraria.WorldBuilding;

namespace Terraria.GameContent.Biomes.Desert;

public static class PitEntrance
{
	public static void Place(DesertDescription description, GenerationProgress progress, float progressMin, float progressMax)
	{
		int holeRadius = WorldGen.genRand.Next(6, 9);
		Point center = description.CombinedArea.Center;
		center.Y = description.Surface[center.X];
		PlaceAt(description, center, holeRadius, progress, progressMin, progressMax);
	}

	private static void PlaceAt(DesertDescription description, Point position, int holeRadius, GenerationProgress progress, float progressMin, float progressMax)
	{
		int num = holeRadius + 3;
		int num2 = num + holeRadius + 3;
		for (int i = -holeRadius - 3; i < holeRadius + 3; i++)
		{
			progress.Set((float)(i + num) / (float)num2, progressMin, progressMax);
			for (int j = description.Surface[i + position.X]; j <= description.Hive.Top + 10; j++)
			{
				double value = (double)(j - description.Surface[i + position.X]) / (double)(description.Hive.Top - description.Desert.Top);
				value = Utils.Clamp(value, 0.0, 1.0);
				int num3 = (int)(GetHoleRadiusScaleAt(value) * (double)holeRadius);
				if (Math.Abs(i) < num3)
				{
					Main.tile[i + position.X, j].ClearEverything();
				}
				else if (Math.Abs(i) < num3 + 3 && value > 0.35)
				{
					Main.tile[i + position.X, j].ResetToType(397);
				}
				double num4 = Math.Abs((double)i / (double)holeRadius);
				num4 *= num4;
				if (Math.Abs(i) < num3 + 3 && (double)(j - position.Y) > 15.0 - 3.0 * num4)
				{
					Main.tile[i + position.X, j].wall = 187;
					WorldGen.SquareWallFrame(i + position.X, j - 1);
					WorldGen.SquareWallFrame(i + position.X, j);
				}
			}
		}
		holeRadius += 4;
		for (int k = -holeRadius; k < holeRadius; k++)
		{
			int num5 = holeRadius - Math.Abs(k);
			num5 = Math.Min(10, num5 * num5);
			for (int l = 0; l < num5; l++)
			{
				Main.tile[k + position.X, l + description.Surface[k + position.X]].ClearEverything();
			}
		}
	}

	private static double GetHoleRadiusScaleAt(double yProgress)
	{
		if (yProgress < 0.6)
		{
			return 1.0;
		}
		return (1.0 - SmootherStep((yProgress - 0.6) / 0.4)) * 0.5 + 0.5;
	}

	private static double SmootherStep(double delta)
	{
		delta = Utils.Clamp(delta, 0.0, 1.0);
		return 1.0 - Math.Cos(delta * 3.1415927410125732) * 0.5 - 0.5;
	}
}

324	    while (treeStyle[2] === treeStyle[0] || treeStyle[2] === treeStyle[1]) treeStyle[2] = roll6();

24	function setBrick(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): void {

30	export function runTemplePass(

437	function mayanTrap(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, x2: number, y2: number): boolean {

439	  const TRAP = TILE_BY_KEY['v_137_traps']!;

492	    const style1 = Math.abs(tx - px) < 10 && rng.int(0, 2) !== 0 ? 2 : 1;

495	    // L 形铺线:压板 → 陷阱(L3068-3118,含两端点)
496	    const num5 = pickColor(px, j);

498	    while (wx !== tx || wy !== ty) {

500	      if (wx > tx) wx--;
501	      else if (wx < tx) wx++;
502	      setW(wx, wy, num5);
503	      if (wy > ty) wy--;
504	      else if (wy < ty) wy++;
505	      setW(wx, wy, num5);
506	    }
507	    setW(tx, ty, num5);
508	    return true;
509	  }
510	  // 纵向:头顶找天花板,天花板装下向火焰陷阱,两侧墙追加同排陷阱(L3120-3235)

516	  const dist = Math.abs(uy - j);
517	  if (dist < 3) return false;
518	  if (st.type[st.idx(px, uy)] === PLATE || st.type[st.idx(px, uy)] === TRAP

539	  {
540	    let wx = px, wy = j;
541	    while (wx !== px || wy !== uy) {
542	      setW(wx, wy, num9);
543	      if (wy > uy) wy--;
544	      else if (wy < uy) wy++;
545	      setW(wx, wy, num9);
546	    }
547	    setW(px, uy, num9);

219	function solidTile(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {

229	function countTiles(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): { count: number; shroom: number } {
230	  let count = 0, shroom = 0;
231	  const seen = new Set<number>();
232	  const stack: Array<[number, number]> = [];
233	  if (!(x <= 1 || x >= st.w - 1 || y <= 1 || y >= st.h - 1)) stack.push([x, y]);
234	  while (stack.length) {
235	    if (count >= MAX_TILE_COUNT) break;
236	    const [cx, cy] = stack.pop()!;
237	    if (cx <= 1 || cx >= st.w - 1 || cy <= 1 || cy >= st.h - 1) return { count: MAX_TILE_COUNT, shroom };
238	    const k = cx * 100000 + cy;
239	    if (seen.has(k)) continue;
240	    const i = st.idx(cx, cy);
241	    if (!treatAsNoWall(st.wall[i])) return { count: MAX_TILE_COUNT, shroom };
242	    seen.add(k);
243	    if (st.flags[i] && st.type[i] === MUSHROOM_GRASS) shroom++;
244	    if (!solidTile(st, cx, cy)) {
245	      count++;
246	      stack.push([cx - 1, cy], [cx + 1, cy], [cx, cy - 1], [cx, cy + 1]);
247	    }
248	  }
249	  return { count, shroom };
250	}

325	    frontier = [];

327	      if (cx < 1 || cx >= st.w - 1 || cy < 1 || cy >= st.h - 1) continue;

354	            }
355	          }
356	        }
357	      }

360	      }
361	    }
362	  }

365	/** SpiderCaves pass（L17455）1:1：w*0.005 个巢；采样 x∈[200,w-200) y∈[(ws+rock)/2,h-230)；

367	export function runSpiderNestPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink): void {
368	  const count = Math.floor(st.w * 0.005);

371	  for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
372	    let x = rng.int(200, st.w - 201);
373	    let y = rng.int(yMin, st.h - 231);
374	    let c = countTiles(st, x, y);
375	    let tries = 0;
376	    while ((c.count >= MAX_TILE_COUNT || c.count < 500) && tries < retryCap) {
377	      tries++;
378	      x = rng.int(200, st.w - 201);
379	      y = rng.int(yMin, st.h - 231);
380	      c = countTiles(st, x, y);
381	      if (c.shroom > 1) c.count = 0;
382	    }
383	    if (tries < retryCap) spreadSpider(st, rng, gs, chests, x, y);
384	  }
385	}

	private static void CreateDentForHoneyFall(int x, int y, int dir)
	{
		dir *= -1;
		y++;
		int num = 0;
		while ((num < 4 || WorldGen.SolidTile(x, y)) && x > 10 && x < Main.maxTilesX - 10)
		{
			num++;
			x += dir;
			if (WorldGen.SolidTile(x, y))
			{
				WorldGen.PoundTile(x, y);
				if (!Main.tile[x, y + 1].active())
				{
					Main.tile[x, y + 1].active(active: true);
					Main.tile[x, y + 1].type = 225;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private static void CreateBlockedHoneyCube(int x, int y)
	{
		for (int i = x - 1; i <= x + 2; i++)
		{
			for (int j = y - 1; j <= y + 2; j++)
			{
				if (i >= x && i <= x + 1 && j >= y && j <= y + 1)
				{
					Main.tile[i, j].active(active: false);
					Main.tile[i, j].liquid = byte.MaxValue;
					Main.tile[i, j].honey(honey: true);
				}
				else
				{
					Main.tile[i, j].active(active: true);
					Main.tile[i, j].type = 225;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private static bool SpotActuallyNotInHive(int x, int y)
	{
		for (int i = x - 1; i <= x + 2; i++)

			for (int j = y - 1; j <= y + 2; j++)

					return true;
				}
				if (Main.tile[i, j].active() && Main.tile[i, j].type != 225)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

			return !Main.tile[x + 1, y + 1].active();
		}
		return true;
	}

Key findings for item 9 (Pots pass):

Also important RNG detail: `int style = genRand.Next(0, 4);` — style is rolled per candidate BEFORE checking the style overrides. So every candidate y row consumes Next(0,4)?? Wait no. Look: inside the else-if branch (`!((double)num13 < Main.worldSurface) || wall != 0`), the FIRST thing is `int style = genRand.Next(0, 4);` then checks tile active && !oceanDepths && ... — so the Next(0,4) is consumed even when the candidate fails! And subsequent style overrides each consume Next(...) only when their condition matches. And `PlacePot` consumes `genRand.Next(3)*36` only on success.

Our current JS: computes `potStyle()` (consuming rng.int) only after all the continue checks pass — and potStyle consumes rng.int for the matched branch only, not an unconditional Next(0,4) first. Also we don't consume variant unless placed (correct per PlacePot), but the style RNG consumption order differs from vanilla.

			DeActive(i, j);
		}
	}

function fireworkToilet(w: Wiring, ctx: DeviceCtx, x: number, y: number): void {
  const st = w.st;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);

  w.skipCell(x, num68); w.skipCell(x, num68 + 1); // :1501-1502

/** 巨石雕像 531(Wiring.cs:1747-1762) */
function fireBoulderStatue(w: Wiring, ctx: DeviceCtx, x: number, y: number): void {
  const st = w.st;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  const ox = x - Math.floor(st.frameX[i] % 36 / 18);
  const oy = y - Math.floor(st.frameY[i] % 36 / 18);

26	export function runFloatingIslandsPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
27	  const { w } = st;
28	  // 原版 pass 21（L5552-5637）：岛数 = w*0.0008，另加 skyLakes（1 + w>8000 + w>6000）。
29	  // 前 islands 个 = CloudIsland，其余 = CloudLake；间距/中心避让为固定值（不缩放）
30	  const islands = Math.floor(w * 0.0008);
31	  let skyLakes = 1;
32	  if (w > 8000) skyLakes++;
33	  if (w > 6000) skyLakes++;
34	  const total = islands + skyLakes;
35	  const placed: number[] = [];
36	  let lakeIdx = 0;
37	  for (let n = 0; n < total; n++) {
38	    let x = 0, ok = false;
39	    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 200 && !ok; attempt++) {
40	      // 原版（WorldGen.cs:13017-13028）：x = Next(0.1w, 0.9w)，仅 |x-w/2|<150 重掷。
41	      // 重掷带宽扩为 ±max(150, 0.05w)：与刷怪器 skyMob 中央带（NPC.cs:1290 段：
42	      // x<0.45w||x>0.55w 之外不判天空怪）完全重合——既 1:1 保留原版全域分布，
43	      // 又保证岛不落进"当地表刷僵尸/水母"的窄缝（曾误修成两侧 8%~42% 带，过度收窄）
44	      const band = Math.max(150, Math.floor(w * 0.05));
45	      x = rng.int(Math.floor(w * 0.1), Math.floor(w * 0.9) - 1);
46	      if (Math.abs(x - w / 2) < band) continue;
47	      ok = placed.every((px) => Math.abs(px - x) >= 180);
48	    }
49	    // 该列地表（原版从 y=200 起扫）
50	    let surf = 0;
51	    let found = false;
52	    for (let y = 200; y < gs.worldSurface; y++) {
53	      if (st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) { surf = y; found = true; break; }
54	    }
55	    if (!found) continue;
56	    // 原版（cs:13072/13093）：y = Next(90, surf-100) 后 min(y, worldSurfaceLow-50)，无
57	    // 0.35 钳（曾有 y 钳把岛整体抬高，已删）——skyMob 由刷怪侧"露天高空"判定兜底。
58	    // 下限取 102 而非原版字面 90：岛的列顶游走最多再上漂 13 格（vy -0.44×29 步），
59	    // 岛树最高 29 格——90 下限时树冠可探进 y<60 深空（违反 sky-invariant 不变量；
60	    // 原版岛树是从岛体随机游走找点种植、不贴最高凸起，故 90 即可，此处按实测补偿）
61	    const y = Math.min(rng.int(102, Math.max(103, surf - 100)), gs.worldSurfaceLow - 50);
62	    const isLake = lakeIdx >= islands;
63	    if (isLake) cloudLake(st, rng, x, y);
64	    else cloudIsland(st, rng, x, y);
65	    placed.push(x);
66	    gs.floatingIslands.push({ x, y, style: 0, isLake });
67	    if (!isLake) lakeIdx++;
68	  }
69	}

71	/** 雨云凸包（CloudIsland L47484-47522 / CloudLake 尾段同构）：
72	 *  自 bbox 左+Next(5) 起，步进 Next(r, 1.5r)；每步从岛底向上找实心面，
73	 *  中心下移 Next(-3,4)，椭圆 r=Next(4,8)（纵压×2），1/4 雨云 196 其余云 189 */
74	function rainBumps(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, bx0: number, bx1: number, by0: number, by1: number): void {
75	  const RAIN = TILE_BY_KEY['v_196_rain_cloud_block']!;
76	  let r = rng.int(4, 7);
77	  for (let x = bx0 + rng.int(0, 4); x < bx1; x += rng.int(r, Math.floor(r * 1.5))) {
78	    let y = by1;
79	    while (y > 1 && !st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) y--;
80	    const cy = y + rng.int(-3, 3);
81	    r = rng.int(4, 7);
82	    const mat = rng.int(0, 3) === 0 ? RAIN : CLOUD;
83	    for (let dx = -r; dx <= r; dx++) {
84	      for (let dy = -r; dy <= r; dy++) {
85	        const tx = x + dx, ty = cy + dy;
86	        if (ty <= by0 || !st.inBounds(tx, ty)) continue;
87	        if (Math.hypot(dx, dy * 2) < r + rng.int(0, 1)) {
88	          const ti = st.idx(tx, ty);
89	          st.type[ti] = mat; st.flags[ti] = 1;
90	        }
91	      }
92	    }
93	  }
94	}

96	/** CloudLake（L47704）：天湖 = 纯云盘 + 雨云凸包（无土芯/无墙/无水池） */
97	function cloudLake(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, i: number, j: number): void {
98	  let num1 = rng.int(100, 149);
99	  let steps = rng.int(20, 29);
100	  let px = i + 0.0, py = j + 0.0;
101	  let vx = rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.2;
102	  while (vx > -2 && vx < 2) vx = rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.2;
103	  let vy = rng.int(-20, -11) * 0.02;
104	  let bx0 = i, bx1 = i, by0 = j, by1 = j;
105	  while (num1 > 0 && steps > 0) {
106	    num1 -= rng.int(0, 3);
107	    steps--;
108	    const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(px - num1 * 0.5)), x1 = Math.min(st.w, Math.floor(px + num1 * 0.5));
109	    const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(py - num1 * 0.5)), y1 = Math.min(st.h, Math.floor(py + num1 * 0.5));
110	    const r = num1 * rng.int(80, 119) * 0.01;
111	    let top = py + 1;
112	    for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
113	      if (rng.next() < 0.5) top += rng.int(-1, 1);
114	      top = Math.max(py, Math.min(py + 2, top));
115	      for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {
116	        if (y <= top || !st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
117	        if (Math.hypot(x - px, (y - py) * 3) < r * 0.4) {
118	          const ti = st.idx(x, y);
119	          st.type[ti] = CLOUD; st.flags[ti] = 1;
120	          bx0 = Math.min(bx0, x); bx1 = Math.max(bx1, x);
121	          by0 = Math.min(by0, y); by1 = Math.max(by1, y);
122	        }
123	      }
124	    }
125	    px += vx; py += vy;
126	    vx += rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.05;
127	    vx = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, vx));
128	    vy = Math.max(-0.2, Math.min(0.2, vy));
129	  }
130	  if (bx1 > bx0) rainBumps(st, rng, bx0, bx1, by0, by1);
131	}

133	/** CloudIsland(L47397)核心移植:扁平云盘(纵压3+顶面游走)→雨云凸包→
134	 * 土芯只嵌云内 → 内部云墙 73 → 10% 水池。岛屋由独立 pass 处理。 */
135	function cloudIsland(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, i: number, j: number): void {
136	  let num1 = rng.int(100, 149);
137	  let steps = rng.int(20, 29);
138	  let px = i + 0.0, py = j + 0.0;
139	  let vx = rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.2;
140	  while (vx > -2 && vx < 2) vx = rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.2;
141	  let vy = rng.int(-20, -11) * 0.02;
142	  let bboxX0 = i, bboxX1 = i, bboxY0 = j, bboxY1 = j;
143	  while (num1 > 0 && steps > 0) {
144	    num1 -= rng.int(0, 3);
145	    steps--;
146	    const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(px - num1 * 0.5)), x1 = Math.min(st.w, Math.floor(px + num1 * 0.5));
147	    const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(py - num1 * 0.5)), y1 = Math.min(st.h, Math.floor(py + num1 * 0.5));
148	    const r = num1 * rng.int(80, 119) * 0.01;
149	    let top = py + 1; // 每列顶面游走(钳 [py, py+2])
150	    for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
151	      if (rng.next() < 0.5) top += rng.int(-1, 1);
152	      top = Math.max(py, Math.min(py + 2, top));
153	      for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {
154	        if (y <= top || !st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
155	        if (Math.hypot(x - px, (y - py) * 3) < r * 0.4) {
156	          const ti = st.idx(x, y);
157	          st.type[ti] = RAIN_CLOUD;
158	          st.flags[ti] = 1;
159	          bboxX0 = Math.min(bboxX0, x); bboxX1 = Math.max(bboxX1, x);
160	          bboxY0 = Math.min(bboxY0, y); bboxY1 = Math.max(bboxY1, y);
161	        }
162	      }
163	    }
164	    px += vx;
165	    py += vy;
166	    vx += rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.05;
167	    vx = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, vx));
168	    vy = Math.max(-0.2, Math.min(0.2, vy));
169	  }
170	  if (bboxX1 <= bboxX0) return;
171	  // ---- 阶段2:雨云凸包（L47484-47522） ----
172	  rainBumps(st, rng, bboxX0, bboxX1, bboxY0, bboxY1);
173	  // ---- 阶段3:土芯(80-95,只把云换土)----
174	  let dR = rng.int(80, 94);
175	  let dSteps = rng.int(10, 14);
176	  let dx0 = i + 0.0, dy0 = bboxY0 + 0.0;
177	  let dvx = rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.2;
178	  while (dvx > -2 && dvx < 2) dvx = rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.2;
179	  let dvy = rng.int(-20, -11) * 0.02;
180	  while (dR > 0 && dSteps > 0) {
181	    dR -= rng.int(0, 3);
182	    dSteps--;
183	    const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(dx0 - dR * 0.5)), x1 = Math.min(st.w, Math.floor(dx0 + dR * 0.5));
184	    const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(dy0 - dR * 0.5)), y1 = Math.min(st.h, Math.floor(dy0 + dR * 0.5));
185	    const r = dR * rng.int(80, 119) * 0.01;
186	    for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
187	      for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {
188	        if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
189	        const ti = st.idx(x, y);
190	        if (st.type[ti] === CLOUD && Math.hypot(x - dx0, (y - dy0) * 3) < r * 0.4) {
191	          st.type[ti] = T.DIRT;
192	        }
193	      }
194	    }
195	    dx0 += dvx;
196	    dy0 += dvy;
197	    dvx += rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.05;
198	    dvx = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, dvx));
199	    dvy = Math.max(-0.2, Math.min(0.2, dvy));
200	  }
201	  // ---- 阶段5:内部云墙(3×3 全包裹 → wall 73)----
202	  for (let x = bboxX0; x <= bboxX1; x++) {
203	    for (let y = bboxY0; y <= bboxY1; y++) {
204	      let all = true;
205	      for (let ax = -1; ax <= 1 && all; ax++) {
206	        for (let ay = -1; ay <= 1; ay++) {
207	          if (!st.inBounds(x + ax, y + ay) || !st.flags[st.idx(x + ax, y + ay)]) { all = false; break; }
208	        }
209	      }
210	      if (all) st.wall[st.idx(x, y)] = 73;
211	    }
212	  }
213	  // ---- 阶段6:水池(每列 10% 在云顶凹处放水)----
214	  for (let x = bboxX0 + 2; x < bboxX1 - 2; x++) {
215	    if (rng.next() >= 0.1) continue;
216	    let y = Math.max(1, bboxY0 - 10);
217	    while (y < st.h - 1 && !st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) y++;
218	    const below = st.idx(x, y + 1);
219	    if (y < bboxY1 && st.type[below] === CLOUD) {
220	      const ti = st.idx(x, y);
221	      st.type[ti] = 0; st.flags[ti] = 0;
222	      st.liquid[ti] = 255; st.liquidType[ti] = 1;
223	    }
224	  }
225	}

227	/** 生命水晶(pass 57):area×2e-5,岩层空腔地面 */
228	export function runLifeCrystalsPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
229	  const { w, h } = st;
230	  const yMin = Math.floor((gs.worldSurface * 2 + gs.rockLevel) / 3);
231	  const count = Math.floor(w * h * 0.00002);
232	  let placed = 0;
233	  for (let n = 0; n < count * 30 && placed < count; n++) {
234	    const x = rng.int(40, w - 41);
235	    const y = rng.int(yMin, Math.max(yMin + 1, h - 300));
236	    if (!st.inBounds(x, y + 1) || !st.inBounds(x + 1, y + 1)) continue;
237	    // 2×2 净空 + 下方实心
238	    let clear = true;
239	    for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
240	      for (let dy = 0; dy < 2; dy++) {
241	        if (st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y - dy)]) { clear = false; break; }
242	      }
243	    }
244	    if (!clear || !st.isSolid(x, y + 1) || !st.isSolid(x + 1, y + 1)) continue;
245	    // 原版 AddLifeCrystal(cs:16023-16038):顶行 frameY=0、底行 18
246	    st.setTileSilent(x, y - 1, HEART, 0, 0);
247	    st.setTileSilent(x + 1, y - 1, HEART, 18, 0);
248	    st.setTileSilent(x, y, HEART, 0, 18);
249	    st.setTileSilent(x + 1, y, HEART, 18, 18);
250	    placed++;
251	  }
252	}

254	/** 地表装饰:按生物群系种树/仙人掌/藤蔓/蘑菇(原版 pass 60+ 系列简化) */
255	export function runSurfaceDecorPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
256	  const { w, h } = st;
257	  const isSoft = (t: number) => t === T.TALLGRASS || t === T.FLOWER || t === T.MUSHROOM || t === VINE;
258	  const ud = gs.undergroundDesert;
259	  const inDesert = (x: number) => !!ud && x >= ud.x0 && x <= ud.x1;
260	  let x = rng.int(6, 14);
261	  let sinceLast = 0;
262	  while (x < w - 6) {
263	    let sy = -1;
264	    for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
265	      if (st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) { sy = y; break; }
266	    }
267	    if (sy >= 0) {
268	      const ground = st.type[st.idx(x, sy)];
269	      const relaxed = sinceLast >= 24;
270	      // ---- 树已由 vanilla/TreePass.ts 替换（原版 AddTrees 逐列语义）----
271	      // ---- 仙人掌(沙漠沙/邪恶沙面)----
272	      if ((ground === T.SAND || ground === EBONSAND || ground === CRIMSAND) && inDesert(x)
273	        && !st.flags[st.idx(x, sy - 1)] && rng.next() < 0.12) {
274	        const ch = rng.int(2, 5);
275	        let ok = true;
276	        for (let dy = 1; dy <= ch; dy++) if (st.flags[st.idx(x, sy - dy)]) { ok = false; break; }
277	        if (ok) {
278	          for (let dy = 1; dy <= ch; dy++) st.setTileSilent(x, sy - dy, CACTUS, 0, 0);
279	          x += rng.int(4, 9);

281	          continue;
282	        }
283	      }
284	      // ---- 杂草/花/蘑菇 ----(藤蔓在下方统一扫描)
285	      // ---- 杂草/花/蘑菇 ----
286	      if (!st.flags[st.idx(x, sy - 1)] && (ground === T.GRASS || ground === JUNGLE_GRASS || ground === T.SNOW)) {
287	        const r = rng.next();
288	        if (r < 0.3) st.setTileSilent(x, sy - 1, T.TALLGRASS, [0, 18, 36, 54, 72, 90][rng.int(0, 5)], 0);
289	        else if (r < 0.42) st.setTileSilent(x, sy - 1, T.FLOWER, [108, 126, 162, 180, 216, 252, 342, 540, 594][rng.int(0, 8)], 0);
290	        else if (r < 0.45 && ground !== T.SNOW) st.setTileSilent(x, sy - 1, T.MUSHROOM, 144, 0);
291	      }
292	    }
293	    x++;
294	    sinceLast++;
295	  }
296	  // ---- 藤蔓:挂在悬空草根/草皮下方(洞穴顶/崖底)----
297	  for (let vx = 2; vx < w - 2; vx++) {
298	    for (let vy = 2; vy < h - 2; vy++) {
299	      const i = st.idx(vx, vy);
300	      if (st.type[i] !== JUNGLE_GRASS && st.type[i] !== T.GRASS) continue;
301	      if (!st.flags[i] || st.flags[st.idx(vx, vy + 1)]) continue;
302	      if (st.liquid[st.idx(vx, vy + 1)] > 0) continue;
303	      if (rng.next() < 0.5) continue;
304	      const len = rng.int(1, 8);
305	      for (let k = 1; k <= len; k++) {
306	        const ii = st.idx(vx, vy + k);
307	        if (vy + k >= h - 1 || st.flags[ii] || st.type[ii] !== 0) break;
308	        st.setTileSilent(vx, vy + k, VINE, 0, 0);
309	      }
310	      vy += 10; // 稀疏
311	    }
312	  }
313	}

315	const SANDSTONE_BRICK = TILE_BY_KEY['v_151_sandstone_brick']!;

318	/** 金字塔(pass 38 Pyramids 简化)：候选来自 DunesPass.runDunesPass（原版 DunesAndPyramidLocations
319	 *  WorldGen.cs:11570-11599 → GenVars.PyrX/PyrY，此处 = gs.pyramidSpots）；
320	 *  Pyramids pass(cs:15426-15489)再校验：x∈(300,w-300)、自 PyrY 下扫首个实心格 < worldSurface
321	 *  且为沙(cs:15455)、与既有金字塔距 ≥220(cs:15466)。gs.pyramidSpots 为空时回退旧自掷候选。 */
322	export function runPyramidPass(
323	  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState,
324	  chests: Array<{ x: number; y: number; items: Array<{ id: number; stack: number } | null> }>,
325	): void {
326	  const SAND = TILE_BY_KEY['sand'] ?? 0;
327	  let spots: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> = [];
328	  if (gs.pyramidSpots.length > 0) {
329	    // cs:15446-15489 消费 PyrX/PyrY：自候选 y 下扫到首个实心格，须在 worldSurface 上且为沙
330	    for (const cand of gs.pyramidSpots) {
331	      if (cand.x <= 300 || cand.x >= st.w - 300) continue;
332	      if (spots.some((s) => Math.abs(s.x - cand.x) < 220)) continue; // cs:15466 间距 ≥220
333	      let y = cand.y;
334	      while (y < gs.worldSurface && !(st.inBounds(cand.x, y) && st.flags[st.idx(cand.x, y)])) y++;
335	      if (y >= gs.worldSurface) continue;
336	      if (st.type[st.idx(cand.x, y)] !== SAND) continue; // cs:15455 沙列门禁
337	      spots.push({ x: cand.x, y: y - 1 }); // cs:15470 k--
338	    }
339	  } else {
340	    // 回退：旧自掷候选（沙丘 pass 未产出时的兜底，非原版路径）
341	    const van = st.w / 4200;
342	    for (let tries = 0; tries < 200 && spots.length < 2; tries++) {
343	      const ox = rng.int(500, st.w - 501);
344	      if (Math.abs(ox - gs.jungleX) < Math.floor(600 * van)) continue;
345	      if (Math.abs(ox - st.w / 2) < 300) continue;
346	      if (ox > gs.snowOriginLeft - 300 && ox < gs.snowOriginRight + 300) continue;
347	      const px = ox + (rng.next() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1) * rng.int(0, 200);
348	      let surf = -1;
349	      for (let y = 0; y < gs.worldSurface; y++) {
350	        if (st.flags[st.idx(px, y)]) { surf = y; break; }
351	      }
352	      if (surf < 0 || st.type[st.idx(px, surf)] !== SAND) continue;
353	      if (spots.some((s) => Math.abs(s.x - px) < 220)) continue;
354	      spots.push({ x: px, y: surf + 20 });
355	    }
356	  }
357	  for (const spot of spots) {
358	    const size = rng.int(14, 20); // 半宽
359	    const baseY = Math.min(st.h - 260, spot.y + rng.int(60, 90));
360	    if (spot.x < size + 5 || spot.x > st.w - size - 5) continue;
361	    // 金字塔主体(逐层收窄)
362	    for (let layer = 0; layer < size; layer++) {
363	      const halfW = size - layer;
364	      for (let x = spot.x - halfW; x <= spot.x + halfW; x++) {
365	        for (let y = baseY - layer; y <= baseY - layer; y++) {
366	          const i = st.idx(x, y);
367	          st.type[i] = SANDSTONE_BRICK; st.flags[i] = 1;
368	          st.wall[i] = 34; // SandstoneBrickUnsafe
369	        }
370	      }
371	    }
372	    // 内腔(倒阶梯掏空)
373	    for (let layer = 2; layer < size - 2; layer++) {
374	      const halfW = size - layer - 2;
375	      for (let x = spot.x - halfW; x <= spot.x + halfW; x++) {
376	        const i = st.idx(x, baseY - layer);
377	        st.type[i] = 0; st.flags[i] = 0;
378	      }
379	    }
380	    // 宝箱(内腔底部,cs L12417-12426):style1 金箱,战利品三选一
381	    // (857 沙暴瓶/848 法老面具/934 飞毯)
382	    const bx = spot.x, by = baseY - 2;
383	    st.setTileSilent(bx, by, CHEST, 1 * 36, 0);
384	    st.setTileSilent(bx + 1, by, CHEST, 1 * 36 + 18, 0);
385	    st.setTileSilent(bx, by + 1, CHEST, 1 * 36, 18);
386	    st.setTileSilent(bx + 1, by + 1, CHEST, 1 * 36 + 18, 18);
387	    const lootKeys = ['vi_857_sandstorm_in_a_bottle', 'vi_848_PharaohsMask', 'vi_934_FlyingCarpet'];
388	    const lootId = ITEM_BY_KEY[lootKeys[rng.int(0, 2)]];
389	    chests.push({
390	      x: bx, y: by,
391	      items: lootId !== undefined ? [{ id: lootId, stack: 1 }, ...Array(9).fill(null)] : Array(10).fill(null),
392	    });
393	  }
394	}

396	/** Wet Jungle(pass 43 简化):从丛林草 tile 起挖湿隧道(灌水) */
397	export function runWetJunglePass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
398	  const core = (gs as any).jungleCoreX ?? gs.jungleX;
399	  const JG = JUNGLE_GRASS;
400	  const tunnels = Math.max(4, Math.floor(st.w / 500)); // C# (int)
401	  let dug = 0;
402	  for (let n = 0; n < tunnels * 60 && dug < tunnels; n++) {
403	    const x = core + rng.int(-Math.floor(st.w * 0.12), Math.floor(st.w * 0.12));
404	    const y = rng.int(gs.rockLevel, Math.max(gs.rockLevel + 1, st.h - 500));
405	    if (!st.inBounds(x, y) || st.type[st.idx(x, y)] !== JG || !st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) continue;
406	    const dx = rng.int(-100, 100) * 0.01, dy = rng.int(-100, 100) * 0.01;
407	    digTunnel(st, rng, x, y, dx, dy, rng.int(30, 120), rng.int(3, 6), true);
408	    dug++;
409	  }
410	}

function nearPicture2(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, mainWall: number): boolean {
  const wall = st.inBounds(x, y) ? st.wall[st.idx(x, y)] : 0;
  const rx = wall === mainWall ? 15 : 8;
  const ry = wall === mainWall ? 10 : 5;
  for (let dx = -rx; dx <= rx; dx++) {
    for (let dy = -ry; dy <= ry; dy++) {
      if (!st.inBounds(x + dx, y + dy) || !st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)]) continue;
      const t = st.type[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)];
      if (t === HANGING || t === CATACOMB || t === PAINTING) return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

/**
 * 灯具→墙上开关 + 红线布线(cs L18942-18975/18990-19023):
 * 在灯具 ±12/+3..20 内找两侧皆砖的嵌墙位放开关(136),沿曼哈顿路径铺红线。
 * chandelier=true 时开关位禁邻尖刺(原版两分支条件差异)。
 */
function wireToSwitch(
  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, dc: DungeonCtx,
  lx: number, ly: number,
  ex0: number, ex1: number, ey0: number, ey1: number,
  isDWall: (x: number, y: number) => boolean,
  isBrick: (x: number, y: number) => boolean,
  chandelier: boolean,
): void {
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 1000; tries++) {
    let x = lx + rng.int(-12, 12);
    let y = ly + rng.int(3, 20);
    if (x < ex0 || x > ex1 || y < ey0 || y > ey1) continue;
    if (!st.inBounds(x, y) || st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] || st.flags[st.idx(x, y + 1)]) continue;
    if (!isBrick(x - 1, y) || !isBrick(x + 1, y)) continue;
    if (!hasLineOfSight(st, x, y, lx, ly)) continue;
    const solidSide = (st.inBounds(x - 1, y) && st.flags[st.idx(x - 1, y)] && st.type[st.idx(x - 1, y)] !== DOOR && TILE_DEFS[st.type[st.idx(x - 1, y)]]?.solid)
      || (st.inBounds(x + 1, y) && st.flags[st.idx(x + 1, y)] && st.type[st.idx(x + 1, y)] !== DOOR && TILE_DEFS[st.type[st.idx(x + 1, y)]]?.solid)
      || (st.inBounds(x, y + 1) && st.flags[st.idx(x, y + 1)] && TILE_DEFS[st.type[st.idx(x, y + 1)]]?.solid);
    if (!solidSide || !isDWall(x, y)) continue;
    if (!chandelier) {
      const tL = st.inBounds(x - 1, y) && st.flags[st.idx(x - 1, y)] ? st.type[st.idx(x - 1, y)] : 0;
      const tR = st.inBounds(x + 1, y) && st.flags[st.idx(x + 1, y)] ? st.type[st.idx(x + 1, y)] : 0;
      if (tL === SPIKE || tR === SPIKE) continue;
    }
    // 放开关(2/3 关态帧 18)并布线
    st.setTileSilent(x, y, DSWITCH, rng.int(0, 2) > 0 ? 18 : 0, 0);
    let wx = x, wy = y;
    while (wx !== lx || wy !== ly) {
      st.wire[st.idx(wx, wy)] |= TileStore.WIRE_RED;
      if (wx > lx) wx--;
      else if (wx < lx) wx++;
      else if (wy > ly) wy--;
      else if (wy < ly) wy++;
    }
    st.wire[st.idx(lx, ly)] |= TileStore.WIRE_RED;
    return;
  }
  void dc;
}

/** 简易视线(Collision.CanHit 近似):两点连线采样无实心阻挡 */
function hasLineOfSight(st: TileStore, x0: number, y0: number, x1: number, y1: number): boolean {
  const dx = x1 - x0, dy = y1 - y0;
  const steps = Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) * 4;
  for (let k = 1; k < steps; k++) {
    const t = k / steps;
    const x = Math.floor(x0 + dx * t);
    const y = Math.floor(y0 + dy * t);
    if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return false;
    const i = st.idx(x, y);
    if (st.flags[i] && TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]]?.solid) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

/** AddBuriedChest 近似:从 (x,y) 向下找地面,2×2 箱落其上;推入 chests */
function addChest(st: TileStore, chests: ChestSink, x: number, y: number, tile: number, style: number, itemId: number | undefined, locked: boolean): boolean {
  const def = TILE_DEFS[tile];
  if (!def) return false;
  let gy = y;
  let guard = 0;
  while (guard++ < 60 && st.inBounds(x, gy) && !st.flags[st.idx(x, gy)]) gy++;
  if (!st.inBounds(x, gy) || !st.flags[st.idx(x, gy)]) return false;
  const topY = gy - 2;
  if (topY < 1) return false;
  for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
    for (let dy = 0; dy < 2; dy++) {
      if (!st.inBounds(x + dx, topY + dy) || st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, topY + dy)]) return false;
    }
  }
  const fw = def.vanilla?.fw ?? 2;
  for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
    for (let dy = 0; dy < 2; dy++) {
      st.setTileSilent(x + dx, topY + dy, tile, style * fw * 18 + dx * 18, dy * 18);
    }
  }
  chests.push({
    x, y: topY, locked,
    items: itemId !== undefined ? [{ id: itemId, stack: 1 }, ...Array(9).fill(null)] : Array(10).fill(null),
  });
  return true;
}

	public static bool CanPoundTile(int x, int y)
	{
		if (Main.tile[x, y] == null)
		{
			Main.tile[x, y] = new Tile();
		}
		if (Main.tile[x, y - 1] == null)
		{
			Main.tile[x, y - 1] = new Tile();
		}
		if (Main.tile[x, y + 1] == null)
		{
			Main.tile[x, y + 1] = new Tile();
		}
		switch (Main.tile[x, y].type)
		{
		case 10:
		case 48:
		case 137:
		case 232:
		case 380:
		case 387:
		case 388:
		case 476:
		case 484:
			return false;
		default:
			if (Main.tile[x, y].type >= 0 && TileID.Sets.Boulders[Main.tile[x, y].type])
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (isGeneratingOrLoadingWorld)

				if (Main.tile[x, y].type == 30)

					return false;
				}
			}
			if (Main.tile[x, y - 1].active() && ForbidsSloping(x, y - 1))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return CanKillTile(x, y);
		}
	}

		case 470:

			return false;

		Main.tile[i, j].halfBrick(halfBrick: false);

					{

					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (!quiet)
		{
			NetMessage.SendData(17, -1, -1, null, 14, i, j, slope);
		}
		return true;
	}

/** PlacePot（1456 WorldGen.cs:54082）1:1：2×2（x..x+1, y-1..y）须净空；
 *  下方双列须 nactive && !halfBrick && slope==0 && tileSolid；成功才掷 Next(3) 变体 */
function placePot(store: TileStore, x: number, y: number, type: number, style: number): boolean {
  for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 0; dy++) {
      if (!store.inBounds(x + dx, y + dy) || store.flags[store.idx(x + dx, y + dy)]) return false;
    }
    const gi = store.idx(x + dx, y + 1);
    if (!store.inBounds(x + dx, y + 1) || !store.flags[gi] || store.half[gi] || store.slope[gi] !== 0) return false;
    const d = TILE_DEFS[store.type[gi]];
    if (!d?.solid) return false;
  }
  const variant = rngRef[0]!.int(0, 2) * 36;   // genRand.Next(3)*36（仅成功时消费）
  for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 0; dy++) {
      store.setTileSilent(x + dx, y + dy, type, dx * 18 + variant, (dy + 1) * 18 + style * 36);
      store.half[store.idx(x + dx, y + dy)] = 0;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

/** oceanDepths（WorldGen.cs:10968）：y > oceanLevel 直接 false；海滩列才 true */
function oceanDepthsAt(gs: GenState, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  const oceanLevel = (gs.worldSurface + gs.rockLevel) / 2 + 40;
  if (y > oceanLevel) return false;
  return x < gs.beachDistance || x > gsWRef[0] - gs.beachDistance;
}

(TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1) : -1;\n  };\n  const put = (xx: number, yy: number, fx: number, fy: number) => {\n    if (!st.inBounds(xx, yy)) return;\n    const i = st.idx(xx, yy);\n    st.type[i] = STALACTITE; put(x, y + 1, variation * 18, 18); }\n    }\n    if (STONY.has(above) || mossSheet(above)) {\n      if (preferSmall) put(x, y, 54 + variation * 18, 72);\n      else { put(x, y, 54 + variation * 18, 0); put(x, y + 1, 378 + variation * 18, 18); }\n    }\n    if (above === 368) {\n      if (preferSmall) put(x, y, 432 + variation * 18, 72);\n      else { put(x, y, 432 + variation * 18, 0); put(x, y + 1, 432 + variation * 18, 18); }\n    }\n    if (above === 367) {\n      if (preferSmall) put(x, y, 486 + variation * 18, 72);\n      else { put(x, y, 486 + variation * 18, 0); put(x, y + 1, 486 + variation * 18, 18); }\n    }\n    return;\n  }\n  // 地面石笋：下方实心 + 本格/上格净空\n  if (!solidTile(st, x, y + 1) || st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] || st.flags[st.idx(x, y - 1)]) return;\n  const below = sheetOf(x, y + 1);\n  if (STONY.has(below) || mossSheet(below)) {\n    if (preferSmall) put(x, y, 54 + variation * 18, 90);\n    else { put(x, y - 1, 54 + variation * 18, 36); }\n  }\n  if (below === 367) {\n    if (preferSmall) put(x, y, 486 + variation * 18, 90);\n    else { put(x, y - 1, 486 + variation * 18, 36); put(x, y, 486 + variation * 18, 54); }\n  }\n}"

 "old_string": "/** Wet Jungle(pass 43 简化):从丛林草 tile 起挖湿隧道(灌水) */\nexport function runWetJunglePass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {\n  const core = (gs as any).jungleCoreX ?? gs.jungleX;\n  const JG = JUNGLE_GRASS;\n  const tunnels = Math.max(4, Math.floor(st.w / 500)); // C# (int)\n  let dug = 0;\n  for (let n = 0; n < tunnels * 60 && dug < tunnels; n++) {\n    const x = core + rng.int(-Math.floor(st.w * 0.12), Math.floor(st.w * 0.12));\n    const y = rng.int(gs.rockLevel, Math.max(gs.rockLevel + 1, st.h - 500));\n    if (!st.inBounds(x, y) || st.type[st.idx(x, y)] !== JG || !st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) continue;\n    const dx = rng.int(-100, 100) * 0.01, dy = rng.int(-100, 100) * 0.01;\n    digTunnel(st, rng, x, y, dx, dy, rng.int(30, 120), rng.int(3, 6), true);\n    dug++;\n  }\n}",

  const g = loadGolden(file);
  const gt = g.tiles;
  return generateWorld({ width: 4200, height: 1200, seedText, evil }).then((world) => {
    const st = world.store;
    const n = gt.type.length;
    let typeMismatch = 0, wallMismatch = 0, liquidMismatch = 0;
    const pairs = new Map<string, number>();
    const xBand = new Float64Array(21); // 每 200 列一段
    const yBands = ['天空0-90', '表层90-300', '洞穴300-600', '深层600-900', '地狱900+'].map((band) => ({ band, mismatch: 0 }));
    const sample: DiffReport['sample'] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      // --- tile type ---
      const ourType = st.flags[i] ? V_ID[st.type[i]] ?? -2 : 0;
      const goldenType = gt.active[i] ? gt.type[i] : 0;
      const y = (i / 4200) | 0;
      const x = i % 4200;
      let mismatch = false;
      if (ourType !== goldenType) {
        typeMismatch++;
        mismatch = true;
        const key = `${ourType < 0 ? `OURS(${st.type[i]})` : ourType}→${goldenType}`;
        pairs.set(key, (pairs.get(key) ?? 0) + 1);
        if (sample.length < 8) sample.push({ x, y, ours: key.split('→')[0], golden: String(goldenType) });
      }
      // --- wall ---
      if (st.wall[i] !== gt.wall[i]) { wallMismatch++; mismatch = true; }
      // --- liquid（类型+有无；液量有沉降时序差异，先比类型格数） ---
      const ourL = st.liquid[i] > 0 ? st.liquidType[i] : 0;
      const goldenL = gt.liquid[i] > 0 ? gt.liquidType[i] : 0;
      if (ourL !== goldenL) { liquidMismatch++; mismatch = true; }

Collision.CanHit 1:1 understood:
- Centers: cx1=(x1*16+8)/16 = x1 (since width 16 → +8 → /16 → x1 + 0.5 → int = x1). Actually (Position1.X + 16/2)/16 = (x1*16+8)/16 = x1.5 → int truncation = x1. So num=x1, num2=y1, num3=x2, num4=(y2*16+1+8)/16 = y2 + 9/16 → int = y2. Good: tile coords (i,j) → (index1, y).
- Loop (do-while):
  - if same cell → true
  - if |dx| > |dy|: step x by ±1; blocked if BOTH (num, num2-1) and (num, num2+1) are solid-full (active, tileSolid, !tileSolidTop, slope==0, !halfBrick) → return false
  - else: step y by ±1; blocked if BOTH (num-1, num2) and (num+1, num2) solid-full → false
  - then do-while condition: continue while current cell is inactive OR not solid OR solidTop — i.e., if the current cell is a solid non-platform tile, return false (line passes through a wall).
- Clamp: x∈[1, w-1], y∈[1, h-40].

Note "inActive" — during gen, no actuated tiles, so treat inActive as false.

Port it into DungeonPass as canHit replacing hasLineOfSight. Signature: canHit(st, x1,y1, x2,y2) with the 16px positions implied.

For :1636 addChest — the approximation "向下找地面,2×2 箱落其上". Vanilla dungeon chests use AddBuriedChest (which I've now aligned in BuriedChestsPass). The dungeon's addChest is a local simplified version with a 60-guard fall and no style/loot roll (it takes explicit style + itemId). The vanilla path: AddBuriedChest(x, y, mainItem, false, chestStyle, false, chestTileType) — with the full falling semantics + loot rolls. But our DungeonPass loot is passed explicitly (itemId) and pushed with `locked`.

The cleanest 1:1 improvement without rewriting dungeon loot: make addChest use the same falling semantics as AddBuriedChest: scan down with SolidTile (not flags), bound h-10, and the ±2 boulder/altar proximity. The 2×2 placement with `gy-2` top — vanilla PlaceChest places the chest so its bottom row sits on the ground: chest occupies (x..x+1, gy-1..gy)? Let me check our BuriedChestsPass: topY = gy - 2, cells (x+dx, topY+dy) for dy 0..1 → rows gy-2, gy-1. So chest bottom row = gy-1, sitting ON gy. ✓ consistent with PlacePot semantics (pot at y occupies y-1..y).

For addChest in DungeonPass: same topY=gy-2 placement ✓ already. So the fix = falling semantics (SolidTile + bound) + proximity. Let me apply, reusing solidTile from HalfBrickPass.

export function placeFurn(st: TileStore, cx: number, anchorY: number, tile: number, style: number, anchor: 'bottom' | 'top' = 'bottom', flip = 1, support = true, styleRowH?: number, styleColW?: number): boolean {
  const def = TILE_DEFS[tile];
  if (!def) return false;
  const fw = def.vanilla?.fw ?? def.w ?? 1;
  const fh = def.vanilla?.fh ?? def.h ?? 1;
  const x0 = cx - Math.floor(fw / 2);
  const yTop = anchor === 'bottom' ? anchorY - fh + 1 : anchorY;
  for (let dx = 0; dx < fw; dx++) {
    for (let dy = 0; dy < fh; dy++) {
      if (!st.inBounds(x0 + dx, yTop + dy) || st.flags[st.idx(x0 + dx, yTop + dy)]) return false;
    }
  }
  if (anchor === 'bottom' && support) {
    for (let dx = 0; dx < fw; dx++) {
      if (!st.inBounds(x0 + dx, yTop + fh) || !st.flags[st.idx(x0 + dx, yTop + fh)]
        || !TILE_DEFS[st.type[st.idx(x0 + dx, yTop + fh)]]?.solid) return false;
    }
  }
  const sheet = TILE_DEFS[tile]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1;
  // 权威布局表(FurnitureStyle.ts,TileObjectData+贴图实测):表内 sheet 直接用,
  // 表外尊重调用参数(竖排 styleRowH / 横排列步 styleColW),最终回退通用横排
  const inTable = [42, 33, 49, 34, 100, 93, 91, 240, 241, 242, 245, 246].includes(sheet);
  let bx: number, by: number;
  if (inTable) [bx, by] = furnitureStyleBase(sheet, style, fw);
  else if (styleRowH !== undefined) { bx = 0; by = style * styleRowH; }
  else { bx = style * (styleColW ?? fw * 18); by = 0; }
  for (let dx = 0; dx < fw; dx++) {
    for (let dy = 0; dy < fh; dy++) {
      const fx = flip < 0 ? fw - 1 - dx : dx;
      st.setTileSilent(x0 + dx, yTop + dy, tile, bx + fx * 18, by + dy * 18);
    }
  }
  return true;
}

/** 家具水平镜像(帧 X 翻转:桌椅等 1-3 宽物件整体 +18*fw) */
export function flipFurn(st: TileStore, cx: number, floorY: number, tile: number): void {
  const def = TILE_DEFS[tile];
  if (!def) return;
  const fw = def.vanilla?.fw ?? def.w ?? 1;
  const fh = def.vanilla?.fh ?? def.h ?? 1;
  const x0 = cx - Math.floor(fw / 2);
  const yTop = floorY - fh + 1;
  for (let dx = 0; dx < fw; dx++) {
    for (let dy = 0; dy < fh; dy++) {
      if (!st.inBounds(x0 + dx, yTop + dy)) continue;
      const i = st.idx(x0 + dx, yTop + dy);
      if (st.type[i] === tile) st.frameX[i] += fw * 18;
    }
  }
}

  else if (sheet === 241) { bx = 0; by = style * 54; }
  else if (sheet === 242) { bx = Math.floor(style / 27) * 108; by = (style % 27) * 72; }
  else { bx = style * fw * 18; by = 0; }
  for (let dx = 0; dx < fw; dx++) {
    for (let dy = 0; dy < fh; dy++) {
      st.setTileSilent(x0 + dx, y + dy, tile, bx + dx * 18, by + dy * 18);
    }
  }
}
